prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a single extremely crisp high-fidelity desktop application screenshot, precisely 3:2 landscape. Edge-to-edge first viewport of the actual macOS desktop app Intern-Bot. No bezel, surrounding desktop, photographer's perspective, presentation board, or annotations. Render straight on. A real usable native-feeling application, beautiful considered editorial art direction. Main structure: unified slim top horizontal title/navigation bar spanning the whole window; beneath is a searchable left index about 34% width and one wide selected application dossier about 66% width. The entire work surface is warm paper-white with minimal black ink hairlines and one powerful ultramarine blue (blue screenprinted signage). Top nav: miniature macOS stoplights, "Intern-Bot" wordmark, "Applications" selected with blue underline, "Scout", "Profile", "Answers", "Settings", and "+ New application" at far right as a small outlined button. No other logos.

LEFT INDEX: heading "Applications", a simple search input "Search applications". Six tightly organized but comfortably legible stacked entries, each company bold sans, internship under it, short status. Whole first row selected by light blue background and left blue rule. Exact text, once each, in this order:
Lumen Analytics / Data Science Intern / Needs your answer
Northwind Labs / Software Intern / Ready for review
Harbor Robotics / Robotics Intern / Queued
Fieldstone Capital / Research Intern / Submitted by you
Cobalt Health / ML Intern / Interviewing
Arcadia Grid / Backend Intern / Offer
Do not draw slash characters; they indicate layout divisions. No dates, times, badges with numbers, custom icons per company or filler.

RIGHT DETAIL: Quiet editorial composition like a beautiful industrial design publication. Generous margins, left-aligned hierarchy, modern sans for controls. Upper part is one spatially dimensional editorial header: at left tiny label "Needs your answer" in cobalt with a dot, large magnificent black old-style serif company name "Lumen Analytics" in one or two lines, beneath it "Data Science Intern · Greenhouse". In the right side of this header is a meticulously realistic bold three-dimensional ultramarine enameled binder clip gripping a small thick sheaf of cream paper with a cobalt index tab; bent metal wire arms, enamel soft highlights, layers of paper, delicate cast shadow and a lively slight diagonal, a tiny industrial design object photographed for a museum catalog. Comp integrated into the paper ground with NO frame and NO collision with text. Objects confined to header; no other images or scenery. Beneath a thin rule, clearly displayed: "What dates are you available for this internship?" in a confident readable 28–32 px sans, then the solid dark cobalt rectangular primary button "Answer question". After generous breathing room, quiet compact row "8 of 9 fields verified" above an elegant hairline blue verified-progress rule almost full. A subdued disclosure "Tracking and notes" below. Subtle powder-paper grain if any, very bright ivory, generous typographic white space. Design every pixel like an iA Writer / Vitsœ archive app collaboration, at a practical macOS information scale. No ad or poster, fake handwriting, gradients, marketing slogans, card collage, extra labels or illustrative text. Perfect spelling, readable from a desktop.
